final: WITH per_id_avg AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) as avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ANA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_avg FROM per_id_avg) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_ana, p.avg_ana - o.mean_avg as gap_above_mean FROM per_id_avg p, overall_mean o WHERE p.avg_ana > o.mean_avg ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC LIMIT 10    -- Returns the 10 IDs with highest average ANA values that exceed the mean; all are tied at 4096.0
